name: Grinding Spray
description: Fill the star with a breath of qi and release it straight so it holds its line to the end.

name: Chime Spoke
description: Feel how much qi the star accepts before it turns heavy and measure the load by the fingertips.

name: Sanguine Thinplate
description: A qi-weighted spoke hooks the collar or belt and drags the foe half a step off balance.

name: Blurring Rimpoint
description: Rock back onto the heels and take one short step away so the foe's reach falls short.

name: Tempered Sprinkle
description: A heavily laden star is thrown at the seam of a breastplate and slips in beside the rivet.

name: Gust Tippoint
description: Pad the forearm with a cushion of qi and turn it to roll a heavy swing aside.

name: Lancing Hub
description: Throw upward with a full qi load to reach a foe standing on a balcony or low roof.

name: Glinthub
description: A star weighted to its limit with qi drives through an inch of plank and strikes the target behind it.

name: Toothassault
description: Gather qi in the palm for several breaths and then fling the star at a far mark in one flat line.

name: Hubtorment
description: Throw the star so it crosses the whole width of a room at one height without dipping.

name: Keen Flatpoint
description: Follow the star in the air with the eyes and the qi field and learn where it curves.

name: Gust Whiz
description: Sweep the arm across the chest and loose the star on the back stroke at a target to the side.

name: Gusthub
description: Flick the star's edge across the inside of a wrist that reaches for a weapon.

name: Cornerpoint Jaunt
description: Plant one foot and swing the body around it so a lunge slides past the hip.

name: Glint Peppering
description: Nudge the star in flight with the living qi field so it drifts a hand width onto the mark.

name: Toothplating
description: Hook a spoke over the rim of a shield and wrench so it swings wide of the body.

name: Hoarfrost Centerhole
description: Skim the star along a wall so it rides the stone and emerges beside a hidden foe.

name: Downpour Bladeface
description: Fling a handful of stars and let the qi field spread them into one broad hissing fan.

name: Hailassault
description: Keep the field open and loose star after star so each throw follows the track of the last.

name: Lambasting Hail
description: Throw a thin star at the line where the edge of one armor plate overlaps the next.

name: Hubthrash
description: Drop a thick short-spoked star onto a helm from above with a full swing.

name: Gust Bladeface
description: Push a spoke beneath the edge of a shoulder plate and lever it up to open the joint.

name: Scatter Canter
description: Step in under the sweep of a long axe blade where its head can no longer reach.

name: Iron Hail
description: Concentrate qi into the leading point so the star bites through a thin plate on first contact.

name: Hourwhiz
description: Throw a second star into the dent left by the first so the plate gives way.

name: Hollowspray
description: Hurl a star with qi packed along its whole rim and split a breastplate from edge to edge.

name: Lancing Thinplate
description: A hard throw at a single rivet bursts it loose and lets the whole plate sag open.

name: Raging Peppering
description: Begin a volley with one short flick that draws the foe's eyes to the right hand.

name: Facet Hub
description: Pass stars from the left hand to the right in a tight loop so the throws never pause.

name: Blazespray
description: Fling with the weaker hand across the body to surprise a foe who watches the strong side.

name: Gusttooth
description: Slide a held star around the edge of the guard and rake the cheek behind it.

name: Sustaining Cornerpoint
description: Count stars left in the pouch by feel and pace the breath so the volley does not run dry.

name: Gust Edgeface
description: Retreat in a widening arc so each step opens a new angle for the next star.

name: Ponderous Tippoint
description: Sweep a continuous volley along a line of foes so each in turn must duck behind cover.

name: Hour Sprinkle
description: Send stars at head and knee and belt height together so no single dodge is safe.

name: Ponderous Spoke
description: Cover a withdrawing group with steady stars so pursuers dare not leave their cover.

name: Mayhem Flatpoint
description: Hurl a hundred small stars upward so that they come down as a dense curtain over the zone.

name: Intent Edgeface
description: Hold one unbroken rhythm of throws for many breaths and keep a whole front pinned.

name: Rumblehail
description: Open with one star down the high track and one down the low in a single twin motion.

name: Rumble Spray
description: Alternate the hands so the left track and right track each keep a star in the air.

name: Ravaging Sprinkle
description: A quick flat flick of the wrist sends the star skimming like a swallow across open sky.

name: Ironspray
description: Hold a star in each hand and rake both across the guard in one crossing stroke.

name: Scatter Sprint
description: Slide sideways with feet close together like water along a bank so aim never leaves the target.

name: Bladeface Tincture
description: Sink into a low wide stance like a basin and read the room before the first throw.

name: Tooththrash
description: Loose two stars side by side so they fly as a hawk's two wings toward one mark.

name: Ravaging Whiz
description: Rise on the toes and throw sharply downward so the star drops like a hawk onto prey.

name: Facet Flatpoint
description: Bend the throw like a river around a rock and let the star come in from the side.

name: Unflinching Edgeface
description: Cross both hands before the chest with a star in each and stop a thrust at the junction.

name: Gust Hail
description: Two stars cross paths in mid air and each strikes the side the foe turned to defend.

name: Slag Cornerpoint
description: Throw many stars high so they fall evenly across a basin-shaped yard in one gray shower.

name: Glint Rimpoint
description: Hold the gaze steady like a hawk on a branch and throw level without any wasted motion.

name: Measured Tippoint
description: Breathe out slowly and let the qi field rise above the thrower to take in the whole ground.

name: Whiztorment
description: Close the fingers on a spoke like a talon and drive the point into the arm of a grappler.

name: Racing Whiz
description: Hang a moment on the toes then settle onto the heels at the exact range chosen.

name: Facet Peppering
description: Throw the star steeply upward then let it fall onto the target at the top of its arc.

name: Tempered Spoke
description: Hold two stars like two talons and drive both points into the same patch of armor at once.

name: Unmaking Centerhole
description: Steer a star in a wide loop through the field so it comes at the target from behind.

name: Tearing Hub
description: A star launched straight up falls back on the foe in a hard point-first drop through the field.

name: Glinthail
description: Drop two stars from opposite heights so that each strikes while the foe watches the other.

name: Facetwhiz
description: Release flat from the lip of the guard stance with the free hand held still like a basin edge.

name: Blaze Centerhole
description: Roll the wrist in a smooth stream and let go at the crest so the star skims forward.

name: Granite Rimpoint
description: Slice a held star's edge lightly across the palm that reaches out to seize the thrower.

name: Grinding Spoke
description: Draw stars from both sleeves at once and fan them out toward two separate marks.

name: Chime Thinplate
description: Count slow breaths like a quiet river and feel the stillness settle into the throwing arm.

name: Chimehail
description: Throw one star from each hand along crossing lines so they meet at the target.

name: Mighthub
description: Cross the ground in quick light steps like stepping stones in a ford and keep the arms free.

name: Charter Thinplate
description: Hold two stars as a rim before the body and catch a strike in the hollow between them.

name: Scorching Scatter
description: Sweep an armful of stars along the ground and then up in one rising wave.

name: Spokecloak
description: Cast stars across a doorway or path and set each point upward to cut any foe who crosses.

name: Nova Tippoint
description: Loose the star on the first breath of the gust so the wind carries it onto the mark.

name: Blazehail
description: Stand with the toes at a drop and throw outward with no wall behind to shorten the swing.

name: Spraythrash
description: Whip a spoke out in a hooking slash that follows the foe's turning shoulder.

name: Waningspoke
description: Take a bearing on the target against a far peak and hold it with steady qi.

name: Harpooning Hub
description: Read the gust and throw wide of the mark so the wind bends the star back onto it.

name: Centerhole Leap
description: Step across the wind and loose a star in the moment the gust drops.

name: Glint Bladeface
description: Ride a lane of steady wind with a qi-hardened star that arrives faster than its flight should.

name: Shade Flatpoint
description: Throw a long volley with the wind at the back and never let the stream thin.

name: Scalding Whiz
description: Skim the star along the flat top of the plateau toward a foe on the same level.

name: Rumble Cornerpoint
description: With nothing overhead let the star fly flat and long under the open sky.

name: Sanguine Sprinkle
description: Rake the spokes across the target as the gust drives the foe's own cloak into the face.

name: Exacting Rimpoint
description: Stand firm against the gale and keep the bearing to the target unmoved.

name: Silt Peppering
description: Slide with the gust behind the shoulder so the step covers twice its usual distance.

name: Siltspoke
description: Feel for the drop with the heel and step back along the very lip without looking.

name: Blaze Edgeface
description: Loft a star onto the rising air at a cliff face and let it climb to the foe above.

name: Rupturing Hub
description: Throw wide into the crosswind so the star hooks back in a curve around cover.

name: Implacable Rimpoint
description: Turn the shoulder into the gust and let it carry an incoming thrust past the ribs.

name: Spray Assault
description: Throw many stars into a strong gale so it rakes them across the whole plateau in a line.

name: Raging Spray
description: Cut a thin straight line through the wind and send one star down it faster than the eye follows.

name: Hail Thrash
description: Hold one bearing steadily to the target and throw level along it without correction.

name: Facet Scatter
description: Whip the wrist like a banner in a gale and loose the star at the snap.

name: Granite Peppering
description: Draw a held spoke across the target in one sworn clean pull without any second try.

name: Edgeface Pounce
description: Shift position in short paces timed to the gusts so the foe cannot predict the next angle.

name: Unmaking Bladeface
description: Throw at long range and let the gale bend the star in a wide sweep onto the target.

name: Staggering Hail
description: Pin a cloak or banner to a post so firmly that the gale cannot tear it free.

name: Shade Thinplate
description: Scatter stars wide across the open ground so a charging line must break and slow.

name: Grinding Flatpoint
description: Pour a storm of stars into the gale and let it drive them across the whole front.

name: Granite Tippoint
description: Spin a ring of stars around the body in the wind so any blow meets a ring of points.
